chapter_title: Concerning the Three Days and the Two Deaths

12.original: [which the Father of Greatness has given number to in the reckoning]
12.content: which the Father of Greatness has given number to in the reckoning

spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Three Great States and the Two Spiritual Deaths

**¶1:** There exist three grand states of spiritual progression in all; and also two great and grievous forms of spiritual death.

**¶4:** The first state is the celestial human itself, the divine principle of the heavenly mind. From the time when this celestial principle descended into the abyss of falsity from evil and was overwhelmed by it — and the divine truth proceeding from divine good was sent forth, which went down and bore that principle upward out of submersion — after the celestial human had ascended, the Divine Love and the Divine Wisdom established order throughout the internal and external degrees of the mind: the heavens within and the natural plane below.

**¶5:** Furthermore, the divine truth in its glory came forth and dwelt within the form of celestial wisdom. It revealed its divine likeness, and it separated and purified whatever was of genuine wisdom from its admixture in all things. It proceeded through the inmost celestial states. Until the time when the old corrupted state of the church will be dissolved, all that is false and evil destroyed, the consuming power of divine love released in final judgment, and the completed Divine-Human Form — the Grand Man — ascends into the Divine. These three works were begun in this first state, when the celestial human principle was sent forth together with its five interior faculties of spiritual perception.

**¶6:** In contrast, [GAP-1] the first spiritual death is the falsity from evil that commingled with the five interior faculties of the celestial human principle.

**¶7:** The second state is the time when all who are in good and truth, having prevailed in the spiritual combat against the hells, will be established in their governing states within the new heaven and dwell upon the renewed natural plane. And they reign in the new heaven until the Divine Love itself unveils its own essential form above them.

**¶8:** The duration of their dwelling in the new heavenly state equals the measure of the first state spent in spiritual affliction. They will reign in this manner and experience blessedness in the new heaven.

**¶9:** The great third state [GAP-2] is the time when the Divine Love will unveil above them its own essential form [GAP-3] — and it raises them up [GAP-4] into its own life — and it receives them into its inmost storehouse of celestial good [GAP-5] — and it gives [GAP-6] the very essence of its own life. It can pour out upon them [GAP-7] its celestial blessedness and the delight of divine love, which takes away all affliction that they have undergone through their perception. [GAP-8] Infinite fullness and eternal joy! When the divine grace would satisfy them, it gives to them its [GAP-9] own nature, and they are made wholly new within those gifts.

**¶10:** Also, it can gather them once more into states of celestial peace and spiritual rest, and perfect their spiritual stature to the same measure as the original celestial states. And it sets each interior faculty in its own heavenly state, in its proper dwelling. They will dwell in the new heaven, each within its own appointed state.

**¶11:** Now, when they dwell in their proper states, they will become enriched beyond all measure, eternally, beyond anything belonging to states of time. From then on they will not reckon that former season among them, nor the succession of states, nor the intervals of perception, from one generation of good to the next, forever and ever. The Divine Love will not be hidden from them from this time onward. Rather, it has accomplished its full unveiling to them [GAP-10] — it being revealed to them forever.

**¶12:** These are the three grand spiritual states, [GAP-11] which the Divine Love in its infinite providence has ordained in the order of its unfolding.

**¶13:** In contrast, the two spiritual deaths that I have declared to you are these.

**¶14:** The first spiritual death is from the time when wisdom and truth descended into falsity from evil, and were commingled with the ruling evils of the hells — until the time when truth will become pure, and be separated from falsity in the consuming power of divine love at the final judgment. Whatever of good remains behind contributes to and completes that final Divine-Human Form.

**¶15:** Now, the second spiritual death is the death in which the interiors of those who are in evil shall perish: when [GAP-12] they will be stripped of the illumination of divine truth that gives light to the natural mind. And also they are separated from the spiritual atmosphere of divine life, from which they receive [GAP-13] living respiration of the spirit; and they are deprived of this living interior soul, which [GAP-14] sustains life in the natural plane; and they are cut off and swept away from this completed Divine-Human Form [GAP-15] — and bound within [GAP-16] their own falsities and evils — the perverted will becomes [GAP-17] the source of their torment and their affliction; for their works [GAP-18] consign them to those three degrees of spiritual death;

**¶16:** These are the two spiritual deaths. The first death is within time and state — [GAP-19] but the second death is eternal. It is the second death!

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: There exist three great mighty days in all; and also two great and bitter deaths.

The first day is our father, the Man. From the time when the First Man went down to the abyss of Darkness and drowned in it; and the Living Spirit was sent, who went and bore him up. After the Man had ascended, the Father of Life and the Great Spirit set things in order, and the worlds above and below.

Furthermore, the glorious Ambassador came and dwelt in the ship of the day. He displayed his glorious image, and he purified the light out of all things. He walked in the heights of the heavens. Till the time when the world will be dissolved, all things destroyed, the great fire released, and the Last Statue ascends. These three deeds were begun on this first day, when they sent the First Man with his five sons.
In contrast, [the first death] is the Darkness that mixed with the five sons of the First Man.

The second day is the time when the fathers of light, who were victorious in the struggle, will sit on their thrones in the new aeon and dwell on the new earth. And they reign in the new aeon till the Father unveils his image above them.
The length of the sojourn in the new aeon equals the measure of the first day spent in affliction. They will reign like this and rejoice in the new aeon.

The great third day [is the time] when the Father will unveil over them his image [the form of his greatness and his glory] and he raises them up [to the light] and he receives them into his hidden treasury [of the light] and he gives [to them] his soul. He can pour out upon them [without measure] his ambrosia and his sweet perfume, which takes away all affliction that they have seen with their eyes. [and brings them] fullness and a joy eternal! When his grace would sate them, he gives to them his [garments] and they are made anew in them.

Also, he can summon them once more in peace and silence, and perfect their stature in same measure as his first aeons. And he sets each power in its aeon, in its dwelling-place. They will dwell in the new aeon in their aeons!

Now, when they dwell in their aeons, they will become rich beyond measure, for ever, beyond time. From then on they will not count that season amongst them; nor the number of the days, nor the hours, generation after generation, for ever and ever. The Father will not be hidden from them, from this time on. Rather, he has accomplished (his) unveiling to them [in fullness] he being revealed to them for ever.
These are the three great days, [which the Father of Greatness has given number to in the reckoning].
In contrast, the two deaths that I have proclaimed to you are these.

The first death is from the time when the light fell to the Darkness, and was mixed in with the rulers of Darkness; until the time when the light will become pure, and be separated from the Darkness in that great fire. The remainder left behind there can build and add to that Last Statue.

Now, the second death is the death in which the souls of sinful men shall die; when [they will] be stripped of the shining light that illuminates the world. And also they are separated from the living air, from which they receive [living] breath; and they are deprived of this living soul, which [gives life] in the world; and they are separated and swept away from this Last Statue [that shall ascend to the light. They are cast down] and bound on [the globe of Darkness. And] the female will become [the cause of] their torture and their affliction; for their deeds [shall cast them into] those three places;
These are the two deaths. The first death is temporal; [but] the second death is eternal. It is the sec[ond deat]h!

fills.explanation: The paragraph contrasts the first day (¶4–5) with the first death, matching the structural pairing of "three great days" and "two great deaths" announced in ¶1; the spiritual reading confirms this is the first form of spiritual death.

This matches the formulaic pattern established in ¶7 ("The second day is the time when...") and the spiritual reading confirms the third state is defined as a time when the Divine Love unveils its form.

fills.fill: the form of his greatness and his glory
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading positions GAP-3 as qualifying the unveiled "essential form"; an appositive elaboration using "greatness" (the Father's defining attribute throughout the Kephalaia) and "glory" (already associated with the divine image in ¶5) is the natural descriptive expansion in this register.

The spiritual reading says "raises them up into its own life," which in the Kephalaia's natural register corresponds to the standard Manichaean phrase "to the light" — the divine life being identified with the light of the Father.

The spiritual reading describes the "inmost storehouse of celestial good," which in standard Manichaean vocabulary is the "Treasury of the Light" — the phrase "hidden treasury of the light" is a well-attested Kephalaia formula.

The spiritual reading says "gives [GAP-6] the very essence of its own life," requiring an indirect object; "to them" completes the giving formula matching the pattern "he gives to them" found later in the same paragraph.

The third state is explicitly characterized in ¶11 as "beyond measure, for ever, beyond time"; "without measure" qualifies the divine outpouring in the same register and thematically anticipates that later description of boundless abundance.

The relative clause "which takes away all affliction" naturally extends with a second predicate — "and brings them fullness and a joy eternal" — completing the twofold action of the divine perfume: removing affliction and bestowing blessedness.

The spiritual reading says "its own nature, and they are made wholly new within those gifts" — in the Kephalaia's register, "garments of light" are the standard vehicle of spiritual renewal; the plural noun "garments" also agrees with the plural pronoun "in them."

The spiritual reading specifies "its full unveiling," and "in fullness" expresses the completeness and totality of the Father's self-disclosure in the Kephalaia's register, contrasting with the preceding statement that the Father will no longer be hidden.

fills.fill: which the Father of Greatness has given number to in the reckoning
fills.original: which the Father of Greatness has given number to in the reckoning
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "which the Divine Love in its infinite providence has ordained in the order of its unfolding"; the editor's reconstruction uses standard Kephalaia vocabulary — "Father of Greatness" for the supreme deity and "given number to in the reckoning" for divine ordering — which accurately conveys this spiritual reality.

The spiritual reading confirms the subject and future tense: "when they will be stripped of the illumination of divine truth"; the editor's "they will" correctly supplies the subject and auxiliary for the passive verb "be stripped."

The spiritual reading says "living respiration of the spirit," and "living breath" is the standard Manichaean formula for the spiritual atmosphere that sustains the soul; confirming the editor's choice.
The spiritual reading says "sustains life in the natural plane"; in the Kephalaia's register, the Living Soul (anima viva) is the light element that animates and gives life to the world of matter.

fills.fill: that shall ascend to the light. They are cast down
fills.explanation: The Last Statue's ascent is established in ¶5; a relative clause here creates the essential thematic contrast — the Statue ascends to the light while the sinful souls are cast down — bridging naturally to "and bound on" in the next clause.

The globe (bolos) of Darkness is the standard Kephalaia eschatological term for the final prison where all irredeemable evil is sealed; "bound on the globe of Darkness" names the specific location of punishment, and "And" transitions to the next clause about the female.

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the source of their torment," meaning the female (perverted will/Az) becomes the active origin of punishment; "the cause of" renders this causal relationship in the Kephalaia's expository register.

The spiritual reading says their works "consign them to those three degrees of spiritual death"; in the Kephalaia's judgment vocabulary, "cast into" is the standard verb for souls being consigned to places of punishment by their own deeds.

The spiritual reading confirms the contrastive conjunction: "The first death is within time and state — but the second death is eternal"; the adversative "but" is the natural connector between the temporal first death and the eternal second death.
